Container.Name: dedupearr
Container.Overview: Dedupearr: the truth about your storage. For every video file under your media and download folders it tells you what the file is - the real copy, a hardlink that costs nothing, a second copy that wastes space, a download nothing in the library matches, or an old recycle-bin entry - with the evidence in one plain sentence. Phase 1 is read-only: it looks and tells. Companion to Auditarr.
Container.Requires: Mount the library and the download folders through ONE path (/data below), as the arr guides recommend; otherwise hardlinks cannot be seen.

Config.Name: Data (library + downloads, read-only)
Config.Description: one share that holds both the library and the download folders

Config.Name: RECYCLE_DAYS
Config.Description: recycle-bin files older than this are waste

Config.Name: HASH_BUDGET_MB
Config.Description: full checksums per scan; beyond it duplicates are called 'very likely' from samples
